title: Promise and Challenges of Distimation
summary: Estimating the quality of raw entangled states and distilling high-fidelity entanglement traditionally require two separate link-layer protocols in a quantum network stack, each consuming its own share of fragile entangled pairs. The recently introduced distimation concept merges these two protocols by directly extracting state estimation data from the classical syndromes generated during entanglement distillation.
